export class PhoenixLedgerDOv2 {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
    this.sql = state.storage.sql;

    this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
      this.sql.exec(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revenue_events (
          stitch_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          kind      TEXT NOT NULL,
          status    TEXT NOT NULL,     -- PENDING | COMMITTED | FAILED
          payload   TEXT NOT NULL,     -- canonical JSON
          result    TEXT,              -- canonical JSON (committed response)
          error     TEXT,
          tries     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
          next_try  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   -- epoch ms
          created_ts TEXT NOT NULL,
          updated_ts TEXT NOT NULL
        );
      `);

      this.sql.exec(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbox (
          id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
          stitch_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          op        TEXT NOT NULL,      -- e.g. "LEDGER_APPEND", "CRM_PUSH", "ADS_ATTRIB"
          status    TEXT NOT NULL,      -- PENDING | DONE | FAILED
          tries     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
          next_try  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   -- epoch ms
          last_err  TEXT,
          created_ts TEXT NOT NULL,
          updated_ts TEXT NOT NULL
        );
      `);

      // Helpful index
      this.sql.exec(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS outbox_due ON outbox(status, next_try);`);
    });
  }

  async _auth(req) {
    const reqId = req.headers.get("x-phx-request-id") || "";
    const tok = req.headers.get("x-phx-internal") || "";
    const seed = `${safeStr(this.env.SOVEREIGN_KEY)}::PHX_INTERNAL_V2::${reqId}`;
    const exp = await sha256Hex(seed);
    if (!ctEq(tok, exp)) HALT("UNAUTH_INTERNAL", "Internal token mismatch");
  }

  _canon(obj) {
    // Deterministic canonical JSON (stable keys) for hashing and equality
    const stable = (x) => {
      if (Array.isArray(x)) return x.map(stable);
      if (x && typeof x === "object") {
        const out = {};
        for (const k of Object.keys(x).sort()) out[k] = stable(x[k]);
        return out;
      }
      return x;
    };
    return JSON.stringify(stable(obj));
  }

  _backoffMs(tries) {
    // Fast early retries, then slower; capped.
    // 0->0s,1->1s,2->2s,3->5s,4->10s,5->20s,6->30s,7->60s...
    const seq = [0, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, 20000, 30000, 60000, 120000, 300000];
    return seq[Math.min(seq.length - 1, Math.max(0, tries))];
  }

        if (row?.status === "COMMITTED" && row?.result) {

        }

  async _ensureAlarmSoon() {
    // If there is pending work due now, schedule near-future alarm.
    const now = Date.now();
    const due = this.sql.exec(
      "SELECT id FROM outbox WHERE status='PENDING' AND next_try <= ? ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1",

    if (due) {

    if (next?.next_try) {

        const nextHeight = prevHeight + 1;

        // Deterministic hash

        const hash = await sha256Hex(`H:${nextHeight}:${prevHash}:${payloadStr}`);

        const block = {
          height: nextHeight,

          kind,
          payload,

        };

        // Atomic write
        await this.state.storage.put({
          [`block:${nextHeight}`]: block,
          [`block:${nextHeight}:hash`]: hash,
          "height": nextHeight
        });

        return new Response(JSON.stringify({

          height: nextHeight,
          hash,
          prev_hash: prevHash
        }), {
          status: 200,
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
        });
      });
    }

    return new Response("OK", { status: 200 });
  }
}

const VERSION = "v100.5-DIAMOND";
const REALITY = "C";

const LIMITS = Object.freeze({
  maxBodyBytes: 64 * 1024,
  chatMaxChars: 4000,
});

const te = new TextEncoder();

function safeStr(x) {
  return x === null || x === undefined ? "" : String(x);
}

function HALT(code, detail, extra) {
  const e = new Error(`[HALT:${safeStr(code)}] ${safeStr(detail)}`);
  e.phx = { code: safeStr(code), detail: safeStr(detail), ...(extra || {}) };
  throw e;
}

function assert(cond, code, detail) {
  if (!cond) HALT(code, detail);
}

// timing-safe-ish: length mismatch returns false (acceptable for this posture)
function ctEq(a, b) {
  a = safeStr(a);
  b = safeStr(b);
  if (!a || !b || a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return diff === 0;
}

async function sha256Hex(s) {
  const buf = te.encode(safeStr(s));
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buf);
  return [...new Uint8Array(hash)].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

function nowISO() {
  return new Date().toISOString();
}

async function readJsonWithCap(req, maxBytes) {
  const t = await req.text();
  if (t.length > maxBytes) HALT("REQ_TOO_LARGE", "Body exceeds limit");

}

          hash TEXT NOT NULL,

          payload TEXT NOT NULL,
          ts TEXT NOT NULL
        );
      `);
      const head = this.sql.exec("SELECT height FROM blocks ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1").one();
      if (!head) {

        this.sql.exec(
          "INSERT INTO blocks (height, hash, prev_hash, payload, ts) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
          0, genesisHash, "GENESIS", JSON.stringify({ kind: "GENESIS" }), nowISO()
        );
      }
    });
  }

  async fetch(req) {
    const url = new URL(req.url);

    if (url.pathname === "/verifychain") {
      if (this.sql) {
        const head = this.sql.exec("SELECT height, hash FROM blocks ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1").one();
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({
          ok: true,
          height: head?.height ?? 0,
          head_hash: head?.hash ?? "GENESIS",
          stone_sky: true,
        }), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

      const height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) ?? 0;
      const headHash = (await this.state.storage.get(`block:${height}:hash`)) ?? "GENESIS";
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, height, head_hash: headHash, stone_sky: true }), {
        status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append") {
      return await this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
        const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const payload = body?.payload ?? body;
        const kind = safeStr(body?.kind || "EVENT");

        if (this.sql) {
          const head = this.sql.exec("SELECT height, hash FROM blocks ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1").one();
          const nextHeight = (head?.height ?? 0) + 1;
          const prevHash = head?.hash ?? "GENESIS";
          const payloadStr = JSON.stringify({ kind, payload });
          const hash = await sha256Hex(`H:${nextHeight}:${prevHash}:${payloadStr}`);

          this.sql.exec(
            "INSERT INTO blocks (height, hash, prev_hash, payload, ts) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            nextHeight, hash, prevHash, payloadStr, nowISO()
          );

          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, height: nextHeight, hash, prev_hash: prevHash }), {
            status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          });
        }

        // KV-API fallback
        const prevHeight = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) ?? 0;
        const prevHash = (await this.state.storage.get(`block:${prevHeight}:hash`)) ?? "GENESIS";
        const nextHeight = prevHeight + 1;

        const payloadStr = JSON.stringify({ kind, payload });
        const hash = await sha256Hex(`H:${nextHeight}:${prevHash}:${payloadStr}`);

        const block = { height: nextHeight, hash, prev_hash: prevHash, kind, payload, ts: nowISO() };
        await this.state.storage.put({
          [`block:${nextHeight}`]: block,
          [`block:${nextHeight}:hash`]: hash,
          "height": nextHeight,
        });

        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, height: nextHeight, hash, prev_hash: prevHash }), {
          status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        });
      });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: "DO_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND" }), { status: 404 });
  }
}

function safeStr(x) {
  return x === null || x === undefined ? "" : String(x);

  return new Date().toISOString();

function HALT(code, detail, httpStatus = 423) {
  const e = new Error(`[HALT:${safeStr(code)}] ${safeStr(detail)}`);
  e.phx = { code: safeStr(code), detail: safeStr(detail), status: httpStatus };
  throw e;

  if (!cond) HALT(code, detail, httpStatus);

function ctEq(a, b) {
  a = safeStr(a);
  b = safeStr(b);
  if (!a || !b || a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return diff === 0;
}

async function sha256Hex(s) {
  const buf = te.encode(safeStr(s));
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buf);
  return [...new Uint8Array(hash)].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

    // Fail-closed serialize + atomic commit
    return await this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
      // Re-check inside lock
      const again = await this.state.storage.get(this._pxIdemKey(idem));
      if (again) return again;

      const student_id = safeStr(event?.student_id).trim();
      assert(!!student_id, "SCHEMA", "student_id required", 400);

      const type = safeStr(event?.type).toUpperCase();
      assert(type === "EARN" || type === "REDEEM" || type === "MINT" || type === "BURN", "SCHEMA", "invalid event type", 400);

      const amount_px = Number(event?.amount_px);
      assert(Number.isFinite(amount_px) && amount_px > 0, "SCHEMA", "amount_px must be > 0", 400);

      // Balance invariant
      const balKey = this._pxBalKey(student_id);
      let balance = Number((await this.state.storage.get(balKey)) ?? 0);
      if (!Number.isFinite(balance) || balance < 0) balance = 0;

      if ((type === "REDEEM" || type === "BURN") && balance < amount_px) {
        HALT("INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS", `Underflow for ${student_id}`, 423);
      }

      const nextBalance = (type === "REDEEM" || type === "BURN") ? balance - amount_px : balance + amount_px;

      // Height
      const height = Number((await this.state.storage.get("px:height")) ?? 0);
      const nextHeight = height + 1;

      const sealed = {
        ...event,
        type,
        student_id,
        amount_px,
        policy_hash: POLICY_HASH_PLACEHOLDER, // TODO_PLACEHOLDER: compute sha256(POLICY_JSON canonical)
        ts: nowISO(),
        px_height: nextHeight,
      };

      const result = { ok: true, px_height: nextHeight, student_id, balance: nextBalance, event: sealed };

      // Commit
      await this.state.storage.put({
        [balKey]: nextBalance,
        [this._pxBlockKey(nextHeight)]: sealed,
        [this._pxIdemKey(idem)]: result,
        [this._pxIdemExpKey(idem)]: Date.now() + ttlMs,
        "px:height": nextHeight,
      });

      // Ensure alarm for GC
      await this.state.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + ttlMs);

      return result;
    });
  }

  async alarm() {
    // GC expired idempotency keys (best-effort; fail-closed not required here)
    try {
      const now = Date.now();
      const list = await this.state.storage.list({ prefix: "px:idemexp:" });
      const deletions = [];
      for (const [k, exp] of list.entries()) {
        const expMs = Number(exp);
        if (Number.isFinite(expMs) && expMs <= now) {
          const idem = k.replace("px:idemexp:", "");
          deletions.push(k);
          deletions.push(this._pxIdemKey(idem));
        }
      }
      if (deletions.length) await this.state.storage.delete(deletions);

      // If there are still future expiries, set alarm to the soonest one
      let soonest = Infinity;
      for (const exp of list.values()) {
        const expMs = Number(exp);
        if (Number.isFinite(expMs) && expMs > now && expMs < soonest) soonest = expMs;
      }
      if (soonest !== Infinity) await this.state.storage.setAlarm(soonest);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  async fetch(req) {
    await this._ensureGenesis();
    const url = new URL(req.url);

    // Ledger verify (called by /verifychain router)
    if (url.pathname === "/verify") {
      const head = await this._getLedgerHead();
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
        ok: true,
        height: head.height,
        head_hash: head.head_hash,
        stone_sky: true,
        ts: nowISO(),
      }), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    // Ledger append (called by /ledger/append router)
    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && req.method === "POST") {
      return await this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
        const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const payload = body?.payload ?? body;
        const kind = safeStr(body?.kind || "EVENT");

        const head = await this._getLedgerHead();
        const nextHeight = head.height + 1;
        const payloadStr = JSON.stringify({ kind, payload });
        const hash = await sha256Hex(`H:${nextHeight}:${head.head_hash}:${payloadStr}`);

        const block = { height: nextHeight, hash, prev_hash: head.head_hash, kind, payload, ts: nowISO() };

        await this.state.storage.put({
          [`block:${nextHeight}`]: block,
          [`block:${nextHeight}:hash`]: hash,
          height: nextHeight,
        });

        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, height: nextHeight, hash, prev_hash: head.head_hash }), {
          status: 200,
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        });
      });
    }

    // PX balance (read-only; router enforces chat-key)
    if (url.pathname === "/px/balance" && req.method === "POST") {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
      const student_id = safeStr(body?.student_id).trim();
      assert(!!student_id, "SCHEMA", "student_id required", 400);

      const bal = Number((await this.state.storage.get(this._pxBalKey(student_id))) ?? 0);
      const px_height = Number((await this.state.storage.get("px:height")) ?? 0);

      const out = { ok: true, student_id, balance: Number.isFinite(bal) ? bal : 0, px_height, policy_hash: POLICY_HASH_PLACEHOLDER };
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(out), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    // PX audit (admin; router enforces sovereign-key)
    if (url.pathname === "/px/audit" && req.method === "GET") {
      const px_height = Number((await this.state.storage.get("px:height")) ?? 0);
      // total_supply is not stored directly here; we can approximate as sum(balances) if we iterate.
      // NOTE: storage.list over all balances may be expensive if huge; OK for early stage.
      const balances = await this.state.storage.list({ prefix: "px:bal:" });
      let total_supply = 0;
      for (const v of balances.values()) {
        const n = Number(v);
        if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) total_supply += n;
      }
      const out = {
        ok: true,
        px_height,
        total_supply,
        policy_hash: POLICY_HASH_PLACEHOLDER,
        policy_version: POLICY_JSON?.version || "TODO_PLACEHOLDER_POLICY_V1",
        ts: nowISO(),
      };
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(out), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    // PX earn (admin; router enforces sovereign-key)
    if (url.pathname === "/px/earn" && req.method === "POST") {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
      const student_id = safeStr(body?.student_id).trim();
      const points = Number(body?.points);
      const trigger = safeStr(body?.trigger || "TODO_PLACEHOLDER_TRIGGER").trim();
      const idempotency_key = safeStr(body?.idempotency_key || body?.idem).trim();
      const proof_ref = safeStr(body?.proof_ref || "TODO_PLACEHOLDER_PROOF_REF").trim();
      const anomaly_score = body?.anomaly_score === undefined ? 0 : Number(body?.anomaly_score);

      assert(!!student_id, "SCHEMA", "student_id required", 400);
      assert(Number.isInteger(points) && points >= 1, "SCHEMA", "points must be integer >= 1", 400);
      assert(!!idempotency_key, "SCHEMA", "idempotency_key required", 400);
      assert(!!proof_ref, "SCHEMA", "proof_ref required", 400);

      // Caps (fail-closed if missing)
      const dailyCap = Number(POLICY_JSON?.daily_points_cap);
      const weeklyCap = Number(POLICY_JSON?.weekly_points_cap);
      assert(Number.isFinite(dailyCap) && dailyCap > 0, "POLICY", "daily_points_cap invalid", 423);
      assert(Number.isFinite(weeklyCap) && weeklyCap > 0, "POLICY", "weekly_points_cap invalid", 423);

      // TODO_PLACEHOLDER: implement per-day/per-week counters keyed by date/week.
      // For now: accept points but flag anomaly if anomaly_score high.
      if (Number.isFinite(anomaly_score) && anomaly_score >= 0.95) {
        // fail-closed path for extreme anomaly
        HALT("ANOMALY", "Anomaly score too high", 423);
      }

      const amount_px = await this._pxConvertPointsToPx(points);

      const event = {
        type: "EARN",
        student_id,
        points,
        amount_px,
        trigger,
        idempotency_key,
        proof_ref,
        anomaly_score: Number.isFinite(anomaly_score) ? anomaly_score : 0,
      };

      const result = await this._appendPxEvent(event, idempotency_key);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(result), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    // PX redeem (admin; router enforces sovereign-key)
    if (url.pathname === "/px/redeem" && req.method === "POST") {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
      const student_id = safeStr(body?.student_id).trim();
      const amount_px = Number(body?.amount_px);
      const sku = safeStr(body?.sku || "TODO_PLACEHOLDER_SKU").trim();
      const idempotency_key = safeStr(body?.idempotency_key || body?.idem).trim();
      const inventory_ref = safeStr(body?.inventory_ref || "TODO_PLACEHOLDER_INVENTORY_REF").trim();

      assert(!!student_id, "SCHEMA", "student_id required", 400);
      assert(Number.isFinite(amount_px) && amount_px > 0, "SCHEMA", "amount_px must be > 0", 400);
      assert(!!sku, "SCHEMA", "sku required", 400);
      assert(!!idempotency_key, "SCHEMA", "idempotency_key required", 400);
      assert(!!inventory_ref, "SCHEMA", "inventory_ref required", 400);

      // TODO_PLACEHOLDER: implement real inventory/capacity checks
      // For now: accept inventory_ref existence as “proof”
      const event = {
        type: "REDEEM",
        student_id,
        amount_px,
        sku,
        idempotency_key,
        inventory_ref,
      };

      const result = await this._appendPxEvent(event, idempotency_key);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(result), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    return new Response("OK", { status: 200 });
  }
}

2.1 Canonical hashing primitives

Leaf hash: Hleaf = SHA256( "PHX1|LEAF|" + leaf_id + "|" + sha256(content_bytes) )

Node hash: Hnode = SHA256( "PHX1|NODE|" + left_hash_hex + "|" + right_hash_hex )

Root hash: computed by pairing nodes in order; if odd count, duplicate the last hash (standard Merkle padding).

2.2 Canonical content rules (critical)

4.1 make_merkle.sh (build root from your repo)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# --- CONFIG (edit) ---
ROOT_DIR="${1:-.}"
OUT_DIR="${2:-.phoenix_merkle}"
mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"

# --- helpers ---
sha256_file() {
  # normalize CRLF -> LF before hashing for text files
  python3 - <<'PY' "$1"
import sys, hashlib
p=sys.argv[1]
b=open(p,'rb').read()
b=b.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
print(hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
PY
}

sha256_str() {
  python3 - <<'PY' "$1"
import sys, hashlib
s=sys.argv[1].encode('utf-8')
print(hashlib.sha256(s).hexdigest())
PY
}

leaf_hash() {
  local leaf_id="$1"
  local file_path="$2"
  local content_hash
  content_hash="$(sha256_file "$file_path")"
  sha256_str "PHX1|LEAF|${leaf_id}|${content_hash}"
}

node_hash() {
  local left="$1"
  local right="$2"
  sha256_str "PHX1|NODE|${left}|${right}"
}

# --- leaf registry (edit to match your actual files) ---
# REQUIRED: create placeholder files if missing
declare -a LEAVES=(
  "A1:constitution_laws.json:$ROOT_DIR/constitution_laws.json"
  "A2:soul_dna_spec.json:$ROOT_DIR/soul_dna_spec.json"
  "A3:gospel_444_spec.json:$ROOT_DIR/gospel_444_spec.json"
  "B1:src/index.js:$ROOT_DIR/src/index.js"
  "B2:wrangler.toml:$ROOT_DIR/wrangler.toml"
  "B3:test_reality_c.sh:$ROOT_DIR/test_reality_c.sh"
  "C1:zenith_moves.ndjson:$ROOT_DIR/zenith_moves.ndjson"
  "C2:kinetic_subsub.ndjson:$ROOT_DIR/kinetic_subsub.ndjson"
  "D1:px_schema.json:$ROOT_DIR/px_schema.json"
  "D2:px_policy.json:$ROOT_DIR/px_policy.json"
  "D3:px_invariants.md:$ROOT_DIR/px_invariants.md"
)

# --- ensure placeholders exist ---
for entry in "${LEAVES[@]}"; do
  IFS=":" read -r leaf_id leaf_name leaf_path <<<"$entry"
  if [[ ! -f "$leaf_path" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$leaf_path")"
    cat >"$leaf_path" <<EOF
MISSING: ${leaf_id} (${leaf_name})
OWNER: <PLACEHOLDER>
REQUIRED_FIELDS: <PLACEHOLDER>
EOF
  fi
done

# --- compute leaf hashes ---
LEAF_LIST="$OUT_DIR/leaves.jsonl"
: >"$LEAF_LIST"

declare -a HASHES=()
for entry in "${LEAVES[@]}"; do
  IFS=":" read -r leaf_id leaf_name leaf_path <<<"$entry"
  h="$(leaf_hash "$leaf_id" "$leaf_path")"
  HASHES+=("$h")
  echo "{\"leaf_id\":\"$leaf_id\",\"name\":\"$leaf_name\",\"path\":\"$leaf_path\",\"hash\":\"$h\"}" >>"$LEAF_LIST"
done

# --- build Merkle root ---
level=0
current=("${HASHES[@]}")

while (( ${#current[@]} > 1 )); do
  next=()
  for ((i=0; i<${#current[@]}; i+=2)); do
    left="${current[i]}"
    right="${current[i+1]:-${current[i]}}"
    next+=("$(node_hash "$left" "$right")")
  done
  current=("${next[@]}")
  ((level+=1))
done

ROOT_HASH="${current[0]}"
echo "$ROOT_HASH" >"$OUT_DIR/root.txt"
echo "PHOENIX_MERKLE_ROOT=$ROOT_HASH"
echo "Leaves written to $LEAF_LIST"
echo "Root written to $OUT_DIR/root.txt"

    if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, error: `PPLX_HTTP_${r.status}` };
    const j = await r.json();
    let text = safeStr(j?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || "").trim();
    text = text.replace(/\[\d+\]/g, "").replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ").trim();
    return { ok: true, text };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: `PPLX_FAIL:${e.message}` };
  }
}

const POLICY_JSON = Object.freeze({
  // <PLACEHOLDER_POLICY_JSON>
  version: "POLICY_V1",
  peg_px_per_point: 0.0015,
  rounding: "floor",
  earn_caps: { per_day_points: 5000 },
  redeem_skus: ["LESSON_ALPHA", "PITCH_SIM", "MASTERCLASS_TIGER"],
  yield_constant: 0.22 // used in treasury logic (placeholder)
});

export default {
  async fetch(req, env) {
    const url = new URL(req.url);

    if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: corsHeaders() });

    try {
      if (url.pathname === "/health" && req.method === "GET") {
        const policy_hash = await sha256Hex(JSON.stringify(POLICY_JSON));
        const body = JSON.stringify({
          ok: true,
          status: "ASCENDED",
          version: VERSION,
          reality: REALITY,
          gospel: 444,
          px_policy_hash: policy_hash,
          ts: nowISO()
        });
        enforceGospel444(body);
        return new Response(body, { status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders(), "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

      // CHAT lane
      if (url.pathname === "/chat" && req.method === "POST") {
        if (!ctEq(req.headers.get("x-chat-key"), env.CHAT_KEY)) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: "UNAUTHORIZED_CHAT" }), { status: 401, headers: corsHeaders() });
        }
        const body = await readJsonWithCap(req, LIMITS.maxBodyBytes);
        const msg = safeStr(body?.message).trim();
        if (!msg || msg.length > LIMITS.chatMaxChars) HALT("SCHEMA", "Invalid message length");

        if (GREET_RE.test(msg)) {
          const out = JSON.stringify({ ok: true, provider: "LOCAL", version: VERSION, response: "Phoenix Online. Awaiting instructions." });
          enforceGospel444(out);
          return new Response(out, { status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders(), "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }

        const enableSearch = wantsResearch(msg);
        const pplx = await callPerplexity(env, msg);
        const response = pplx.ok
          ? pplx.text
          : `Command received: "${msg}". (AI provider offline: ${pplx.error})`;

        const out = JSON.stringify({
          ok: true,
          provider: pplx.ok ? (enableSearch ? "PERPLEXITY(RESEARCH)" : "PERPLEXITY(CHAT)") : "LOCAL_FALLBACK",
          version: VERSION,
          response
        });
        enforceGospel444(out);
        return new Response(out, { status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders(), "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

      // READ-ONLY PX balance (chat-key)
      if (url.pathname === "/px/balance" && req.method === "GET") {
        if (!ctEq(req.headers.get("x-chat-key"), env.CHAT_KEY)) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: "UNAUTHORIZED_CHAT" }), { status: 401, headers: corsHeaders() });
        }
        const student_id = safeStr(url.searchParams.get("student_id")).trim();
        if (!student_id) HALT("SCHEMA", "student_id required");
        const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("GLOBAL");
        const doReq = new Request(`https://do/px/balance?student_id=${encodeURIComponent(student_id)}`, { method: "GET" });
        return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(doReq);
      }

      // ADMIN lane (sovereign-key)
      const isAdmin =
        url.pathname === "/verifychain" ||
        url.pathname === "/ledger/append" ||
        url.pathname === "/px/earn" ||
        url.pathname === "/px/redeem" ||
        url.pathname === "/px/audit";

      if (isAdmin) {
        if (!ctEq(req.headers.get("x-sovereign-key"), env.SOVEREIGN_KEY)) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: "UNAUTHORIZED_ADMIN" }), { status: 401, headers: corsHeaders() });
        }
        const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("GLOBAL");

        // Route /verifychain to DO /verify
        if (url.pathname === "/verifychain") {
          return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(new Request("https://do/verify", { method: "GET" }));
        }

        // Route /px/* to DO /px/*
        if (url.pathname.startsWith("/px/")) {
          const doUrl = `https://do${url.pathname}${url.search}`;
          return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(new Request(doUrl, {
            method: req.method,
            headers: { "Content-Type": req.headers.get("Content-Type") || "application/json" },
            body: req.method === "GET" ? undefined : await req.text()
          }));
        }

        // /ledger/append -> DO /ledger/append (same path)
        return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(req);
      }

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: "NOT_FOUND" }), { status: 404, headers: corsHeaders() });
    } catch (e) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
        ok: false,
        error: e?.phx?.code || "INTERNAL_HALT",
        detail: e?.phx?.detail || e.message
      }), { status: 500, headers: corsHeaders() });
    }
  }
};

export class PhoenixLedgerDOv2 {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;

    this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
      const h = await this.state.storage.get("height");
      if (h === null || h === undefined) {
        await this.state.storage.put({
          "height": 0,
          "block:0:hash": "GENESIS",
          "block:0": { height: 0, hash: "GENESIS", prev_hash: "NONE", kind: "GENESIS", payload: { ok: true }, ts: nowISO() }
        });
      }

      const pxh = await this.state.storage.get("px:height");
      if (pxh === null || pxh === undefined) {
        // PX genesis anchor (Move 64) — store policy hash snapshot
        const policy_hash = await sha256Hex(JSON.stringify(POLICY_JSON));
        await this.state.storage.put({
          "px:height": 0,
          "px:policy_hash": policy_hash,
          "px:block:0": { type: "GENESIS", policy_hash, ts: nowISO() }
        });
      }
    });
  }

  // Alarm handler for TTL / GC (Move 74)
  async alarm() {
    // Deletes idempotency keys older than 24h
    const cutoff = Date.now() - 86400000;
    const list = await this.state.storage.list({ prefix: "px:idem:" });
    const deletes = [];
    for (const [k, v] of list.entries()) {
      const ts = v?.ts || 0;
      if (typeof ts === "number" && ts < cutoff) deletes.push(k);
    }
    if (deletes.length) await this.state.storage.delete(deletes);

    // Re-arm alarm (daily cadence)
    this.state.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 86400000);
  }

  async fetch(req) {
    const url = new URL(req.url);

    // Chain verify (admin)
    if (url.pathname === "/verify") {
      const height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) ?? 0;
      const headHash = (await this.state.storage.get(`block:${height}:hash`)) ?? "GENESIS";
      const headBlock = await this.state.storage.get(`block:${height}`);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
        ok: true,
        height,
        head_hash: headHash,
        stone_sky: true,
        ts: headBlock?.ts || nowISO()
      }), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    // Append general block (admin)
    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && req.method === "POST") {
      return this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
        const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const payload = body?.payload ?? body;
        const kind = safeStr(body?.kind || "EVENT");

        const prevHeight = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) ?? 0;
        const prevHash = (await this.state.storage.get(`block:${prevHeight}:hash`)) ?? "GENESIS";
        const nextHeight = prevHeight + 1;

        const payloadStr = JSON.stringify({ kind, payload });
        const hash = await sha256Hex(`H:${nextHeight}:${prevHash}:${payloadStr}`);

        const block = { height: nextHeight, hash, prev_hash: prevHash, kind, payload, ts: nowISO() };

        await this.state.storage.put({
          [`block:${nextHeight}`]: block,
          [`block:${nextHeight}:hash`]: hash,
          "height": nextHeight
        });

        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, height: nextHeight, hash, prev_hash: prevHash }),
          { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      });
    }

    // PX read-only balance (chat key routed here)
    if (url.pathname === "/px/balance" && req.method === "GET") {
      const student_id = safeStr(url.searchParams.get("student_id")).trim();
      if (!student_id) HALT("SCHEMA", "student_id required");
      const bal = (await this.state.storage.get(`px:bal:${student_id}`)) ?? 0;
      const height = (await this.state.storage.get("px:height")) ?? 0;
      const policy_hash = (await this.state.storage.get("px:policy_hash")) ?? "UNKNOWN";
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, student_id, balance_px: bal, px_height: height, policy_hash }),
        { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    // PX audit (admin)
    if (url.pathname === "/px/audit" && req.method === "GET") {
      const height = (await this.state.storage.get("px:height")) ?? 0;
      const policy_hash = (await this.state.storage.get("px:policy_hash")) ?? "UNKNOWN";
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, px_height: height, policy_hash, ts: nowISO() }),
        { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    // PX earn / redeem (admin)
    if ((url.pathname === "/px/earn" || url.pathname === "/px/redeem") && req.method === "POST") {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
      const student_id = safeStr(body?.student_id).trim();
      const idem = safeStr(body?.idempotency_key || body?.idem).trim();
      if (!student_id || !idem) HALT("SCHEMA", "student_id + idempotency_key required");

      const type = url.pathname === "/px/earn" ? "EARN" : "REDEEM";

      // Move 63/74: idempotency replay protection
      const idemKey = `px:idem:${idem}`;
      const existing = await this.state.storage.get(idemKey);
      if (existing) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, replay: true, ...existing }),
          { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

      return this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
        const balKey = `px:bal:${student_id}`;
        let balance = (await this.state.storage.get(balKey)) ?? 0;

        // Convert points -> px if earn payload uses points
        let amount_px = body?.amount_px;
        if (type === "EARN" && (amount_px === null || amount_px === undefined)) {
          const points = Number(body?.points || 0);
          if (!Number.isFinite(points) || points < 1) HALT("SCHEMA", "points must be >= 1");
          const peg = Number(POLICY_JSON.peg_px_per_point || 0);
          const raw = points * peg;
          amount_px = POLICY_JSON.rounding === "floor" ? Math.floor(raw * 1e6) / 1e6 : raw; // deterministic-ish
        }

        amount_px = Number(amount_px);
        if (!Number.isFinite(amount_px) || amount_px <= 0) HALT("SCHEMA", "amount_px must be > 0");

        if (type === "REDEEM") {
          const sku = safeStr(body?.sku).trim();
          if (!sku) HALT("SCHEMA", "sku required");
          // Move 70: SKU surface (placeholder validation)
          if (Array.isArray(POLICY_JSON.redeem_skus) && !POLICY_JSON.redeem_skus.includes(sku)) {
            HALT("SCHEMA", "sku not allowed by policy");
          }
          if (balance < amount_px) HALT("INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS", `underflow student=${student_id}`);
          balance = balance - amount_px;
        } else {
          balance = balance + amount_px;
        }

        const prevHeight = (await this.state.storage.get("px:height")) ?? 0;
        const nextHeight = prevHeight + 1;

        const policy_hash = (await this.state.storage.get("px:policy_hash")) ?? "UNKNOWN";
        const event = {
          type,
          student_id,
          amount_px,
          sku: type === "REDEEM" ? safeStr(body?.sku) : undefined,
          trigger: safeStr(body?.trigger || "MANUAL"),
          proof_ref: safeStr(body?.proof_ref || "<PLACEHOLDER_PROOF_REF>"),
          idempotency_key: idem,
          policy_hash,
          ts: nowISO()
        };

        await this.state.storage.put({
          [balKey]: balance,
          [`px:block:${nextHeight}`]: event,
          "px:height": nextHeight,
          [idemKey]: { ts: Date.now(), result: { height: nextHeight, balance_px: balance } }
        });

        // Arm GC alarm daily (Move 74)
        this.state.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 86400000);

        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, type, height: nextHeight, balance_px: balance }),
          { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      });
    }

    return new Response("OK", { status: 200 });
  }
}

Everything below assumes you’re currently on the KV-based PhoenixLedgerDOv2 (the “actually deploys” version), not SQLite.

+  async alarm() {
+    // Delete px:idem:* keys older than 24h IF they embed time OR if stored value has ts.
+    // Since we didn't enforce a timestamp format in the key, we do a conservative sweep:
+    // - list() is bounded; keep it small and repeat next alarm if truncated.
+    const list = await this.state.storage.list({ prefix: "px:idem:" });
+    const cutoff = Date.now() - 86400000;
+    let deleted = 0;
+    for (const [k, v] of list.entries()) {
+      const ts = v && typeof v === "object" ? Date.parse(v.ts || "") : NaN;
+      if (!Number.isNaN(ts) && ts < cutoff) {
+        await this.state.storage.delete(k);
+        deleted++;
+      }
+    }
+    // Re-arm alarm for next day
+    this.state.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 86400000);
+    return deleted;
+  }

Notes on this implementation (so other chats don’t “fix” it into drift)
This does not compute a Merkle root over all balances (that would require scanning all keys and is slow/fragile). Instead, it maintains a rolling sha256 root updated per event, which is still a cryptographic “heartbeat” and catches drift/tampering in sequence.

The checkpoint object is stored at px:checkpoint:<height> every CHECKPOINT_CADENCE events.

POLICY_HASH is injected into each event + checkpoint so governance drift is detectable.

"use strict";

/**
 * 🦅 PHOENIX OMEGA — REALITY C MONOLITH v100.6 (MOVE 72)
 * POSTURE: FAIL-CLOSED | KV-BASED DO STORAGE | CHECKPOINT HASHING | GOSPEL 444 (NO BLUE)
 *
 * Placeholders:
 * - <PLACEHOLDER_POLICY_HASH> (wrangler var POLICY_HASH)
 * - <PLACEHOLDER_CHECKPOINT_CADENCE> (wrangler var CHECKPOINT_CADENCE)
 */

const te = new TextEncoder();

function safeStr(x) { return (x === null || x === undefined) ? "" : String(x); }

function json(res, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(res), {
    status,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET,POST,OPTIONS",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type,x-sovereign-key,x-chat-key",
      "Vary": "Origin",
    }
  });
}

async function sha256Hex(s) {
  const buf = te.encode(safeStr(s));
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buf);
  return [...new Uint8Array(hash)].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

function ctEq(a, b) {
  a = safeStr(a); b = safeStr(b);
  if (!a || !b || a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let d = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) d |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return d === 0;
}

export default {
  async fetch(req, env) {
    const url = new URL(req.url);

    if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: {
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET,POST,OPTIONS",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type,x-sovereign-key,x-chat-key",
      "Vary": "Origin",
    }});

    // PUBLIC
    if (url.pathname === "/health" && req.method === "GET") {
      return json({
        ok: true,
        status: "ONLINE",
        version: safeStr(env.PHOENIX_VERSION || "v100.6-MOVE72"),
        gospel: 444,
        checkpoint_cadence: safeStr(env.CHECKPOINT_CADENCE || "100"),
      });
    }

    // ADMIN: verifychain
    if (url.pathname === "/verifychain" && req.method === "GET") {
      if (!ctEq(req.headers.get("x-sovereign-key"), env.SOVEREIGN_KEY)) {
        return json({ ok: false, error: "UNAUTHORIZED_ADMIN" }, 401);
      }
      const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("GLOBAL");
      return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch("https://do/verify", { method: "GET" });
    }

    // ADMIN: append
    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && req.method === "POST") {
      if (!ctEq(req.headers.get("x-sovereign-key"), env.SOVEREIGN_KEY)) {
        return json({ ok: false, error: "UNAUTHORIZED_ADMIN" }, 401);
      }
      const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("GLOBAL");
      return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(req);
    }

    return json({ ok: false, error: "NOT_FOUND" }, 404);
  }
};

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// DURABLE OBJECT: PhoenixLedgerDOv2 (KV storage)
// - Deterministic block hash
// - Checkpoint hash every cadence blocks
// - Policy hash injected at checkpoint blocks
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export class PhoenixLedgerDOv2 {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
  }

  async fetch(req) {
    const url = new URL(req.url);

    // GET /verify
    if (url.pathname === "/verify") {
      const height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) ?? 0;
      const headHash = (await this.state.storage.get(`block:${height}:hash`)) ?? "GENESIS";
      const lastCheckpoint = (await this.state.storage.get("checkpoint:last")) ?? 0;
      const lastCheckpointHash = (await this.state.storage.get(`checkpoint:${lastCheckpoint}:hash`)) ?? null;

      return json({
        ok: true,
        stone_sky: true,
        height,
        head_hash: headHash,
        checkpoint_last: lastCheckpoint,
        checkpoint_hash: lastCheckpointHash,
        policy_hash: safeStr(this.env.POLICY_HASH || "<PLACEHOLDER_POLICY_HASH>"),
      });
    }

    // POST /ledger/append
    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && req.method === "POST") {
      return await this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
        const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const payload = (body && typeof body === "object" && "payload" in body) ? body.payload : body;

        const prevHeight = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) ?? 0;
        const prevHash = (await this.state.storage.get(`block:${prevHeight}:hash`)) ?? "GENESIS";
        const nextHeight = prevHeight + 1;

        const cadence = parseInt(safeStr(this.env.CHECKPOINT_CADENCE || "100"), 10) || 100;
        const isCheckpoint = (nextHeight % cadence === 0);

        const policyHash = safeStr(this.env.POLICY_HASH || "<PLACEHOLDER_POLICY_HASH>");

        // block material (deterministic)
        const block = {
          height: nextHeight,
          prev_hash: prevHash,
          ts: new Date().toISOString(),
          type: isCheckpoint ? "CHECKPOINT" : "BLOCK",
          payload,
          policy_hash: isCheckpoint ? policyHash : undefined,
        };

        const blockStr = JSON.stringify(block);
        const blockHash = await sha256Hex(`B:${nextHeight}:${prevHash}:${blockStr}`);

        // checkpoint hash (deterministic heartbeat)
        let checkpointHash = null;
        if (isCheckpoint) {
          checkpointHash = await sha256Hex(`CP:${nextHeight}:${blockHash}:${policyHash}`);
          await this.state.storage.put(`checkpoint:${nextHeight}:hash`, checkpointHash);
          await this.state.storage.put("checkpoint:last", nextHeight);
        }

        await this.state.storage.put({
          "height": nextHeight,
          [`block:${nextHeight}`]: block,
          [`block:${nextHeight}:hash`]: blockHash,
        });

        return json({
          ok: true,
          height: nextHeight,
          hash: blockHash,
          checkpoint: isCheckpoint ? { height: nextHeight, hash: checkpointHash } : null,
        });
      });
    }

    return new Response("OK", { status: 200 });
  }
}

"use strict";

const te = new TextEncoder();

function safeStr(x) { return (x === null || x === undefined) ? "" : String(x); }

function ctEq(a, b) {
  a = safeStr(a); b = safeStr(b);
  if (!a || !b || a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let d = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) d |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return d === 0;
}

async function sha256Hex(s) {
  const buf = te.encode(safeStr(s));
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buf);
  return [...new Uint8Array(hash)].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

function json(res, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(res), {
    status,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET,POST,OPTIONS",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type,x-sovereign-key,x-chat-key",
      "Vary": "Origin",
    }
  });
}

  async fetch(req, env) {
    const url = new URL(req.url);

    if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: {
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET,POST,OPTIONS",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type,x-sovereign-key,x-chat-key",
      "Vary": "Origin",

    if (url.pathname === "/health" && req.method === "GET") {
      return json({

        gospel: 444,
        checkpoint_cadence: safeStr(env.CHECKPOINT_CADENCE || "100"),
      });
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/verifychain" && req.method === "GET") {
      if (!ctEq(req.headers.get("x-sovereign-key"), env.SOVEREIGN_KEY)) {
        return json({ ok: false, error: "UNAUTHORIZED_ADMIN" }, 401);
      }
      const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("GLOBAL");
      return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch("https://do/verify", { method: "GET" });
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && req.method === "POST") {
      if (!ctEq(req.headers.get("x-sovereign-key"), env.SOVEREIGN_KEY)) {
        return json({ ok: false, error: "UNAUTHORIZED_ADMIN" }, 401);
      }
      const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("GLOBAL");
      return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(req);
    }

    return json({ ok: false, error: "NOT_FOUND" }, 404);
  }
};

export class PhoenixLedgerDOv2 {
  constructor(state, env) { this.state = state; this.env = env; }

  async fetch(req) {
    const url = new URL(req.url);

    if (url.pathname === "/verify") {
      const height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) ?? 0;
      const headHash = (await this.state.storage.get(`block:${height}:hash`)) ?? "GENESIS";
      const lastCp = (await this.state.storage.get("cp:last")) ?? 0;
      const cpHash = lastCp ? (await this.state.storage.get(`cp:${lastCp}:hash`)) : null;

      return json({

        checkpoint_hash: cpHash,
        policy_hash: safeStr(this.env.POLICY_HASH || "<PLACEHOLDER_POLICY_HASH>"),
      });
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && req.method === "POST") {
      return await this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {

        const payload = (body && typeof body === "object" && "payload" in body) ? body.payload : body;

        const prevHeight = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) ?? 0;
        const prevHash = (await this.state.storage.get(`block:${prevHeight}:hash`)) ?? "GENESIS";
        const nextHeight = prevHeight + 1;

        const cadence = parseInt(safeStr(this.env.CHECKPOINT_CADENCE || "100"), 10) || 100;
        const isCp = (nextHeight % cadence === 0);
        const policyHash = safeStr(this.env.POLICY_HASH || "<PLACEHOLDER_POLICY_HASH>");

        const block = {
          height: nextHeight,
          prev_hash: prevHash,
          ts: new Date().toISOString(),
          type: isCp ? "CHECKPOINT" : "BLOCK",
          payload,
          policy_hash: isCp ? policyHash : undefined,
        };

        const blockStr = JSON.stringify(block);
        const blockHash = await sha256Hex(`B:${nextHeight}:${prevHash}:${blockStr}`);

          await this.state.storage.put(`cp:${nextHeight}:hash`, cpHash);

          "height": nextHeight,
          [`block:${nextHeight}`]: block,
          [`block:${nextHeight}:hash`]: blockHash,
        });

        return json({ ok: true, height: nextHeight, hash: blockHash, checkpoint: isCp });
      });
    }

    return new Response("OK", { status: 200 });
  }
}

/**

import { DurableObject } from "cloudflare:workers";



// 1. CRYPTO PRIMITIVES (Safe + Consistent)

async function sha256Hex(str) {

const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(str));

return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

}



// 2. THE GATE (WORKER)

export default {

async fetch(request, env) {

if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {

return new Response(null, { headers: { "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" } });

}

const url = new URL(request.url);



try {

// HEALTH CHECK

if (url.pathname === "/health") {

return new Response(JSON.stringify({

status: "ONLINE",

version: env.PHOENIX_VERSION,

gospel: 444,

mode: "FAIL-CLOSED"

}), { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}



// LEDGER ACCESS (AUTH REQUIRED)

if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" || url.pathname === "/verifychain") {

const key = request.headers.get("x-sovereign-key");

if (!key) return new Response("ACCESS_DENIED", { status: 401 });



const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("OMEGA_PRIME");

return await env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(request);

}



return new Response("PHOENIX GATE: 404", { status: 404 });

} catch (e) {

return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: e.message }), { status: 500 });

}

}

};



// 3. THE AUTHORITY (Active PhoenixLedgerDOv2)

export class PhoenixLedgerDOv2 extends DurableObject {

constructor(state, env) {

super(state, env);

this.state = state;

this.env = env;

}



async fetch(request) {

const url = new URL(request.url);



// VERIFY CHAIN (Read)

if (url.pathname === "/verifychain") {

let height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) || 0;

let head_hash = (await this.state.storage.get("latest_hash")) || "GENESIS";

return new Response(JSON.stringify({

ok: true,

stone_sky: true,

height: height,

head_hash: head_hash

}), { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}



// APPEND (Write)

if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" || request.method === "POST") {

const data = await request.json();

let height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) || 0;

let prevHash = (await this.state.storage.get("latest_hash")) || "GENESIS";



const newHeight = height + 1;

const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();



// CHECKPOINT LOGIC

const cadence = parseInt(this.env.CHECKPOINT_CADENCE || "100");

if (newHeight % cadence === 0) {

data.checkpoint_hash = this.env.POLICY_HASH || "UNVERIFIED";

data.type = "CHECKPOINT";

}



// HASHING

const payloadStr = JSON.stringify(data);

const newHash = await sha256Hex(${newHeight}:${prevHash}:${timestamp}:${payloadStr});



await this.state.storage.put("height", newHeight);

await this.state.storage.put("latest_hash", newHash);

await this.state.storage.put(block_${newHeight}, { ts: timestamp, hash: newHash, data });



return new Response(JSON.stringify({

status: "COMMITTED",

height: newHeight,

hash: newHash

}), { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}

return new Response("DO OK");

}

}

async function sha256Hex(str) {

const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(str));

return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

}

async function sha256Hex(str) {

const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(str));

return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

}

// FILE: src/index.js
// Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects (SQLite-backed Ledger)
// - Fail-closed auth
// - Deterministic ledger (prev_hash chain)
// - Checkpoint cadence + policy hash anchoring
// - Idempotent append (x-idempotency-key)
// - Bounded CAS retry
// - Minimal, explicit endpoints

import { DurableObject } from "cloudflare:workers";

/* ----------------------------- shared helpers ----------------------------- */

const JSON_CT = { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" };

function corsHeaders(origin = "*") {
  return {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": origin,
    "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET,POST,OPTIONS",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers":
      "Content-Type, x-sovereign-key, x-idempotency-key",
    "Access-Control-Max-Age": "86400",
    "Vary": "Origin",
  };
}

function json(obj, status = 200, extraHeaders = {}) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(obj), {
    status,
    headers: { ...JSON_CT, ...extraHeaders },
  });
}

function text(body, status = 200, extraHeaders = {}) {
  return new Response(body, { status, headers: { ...extraHeaders } });
}

function safeInt(v, def) {
  const n = Number.parseInt(String(v ?? ""), 10);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : def;
}

async function sha256Hex(str) {
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest(
    "SHA-256",
    new TextEncoder().encode(str)
  );
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf))
    .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join("");
}

function nowIso() {
  return new Date().toISOString();
}

function requireSovereign(request, env) {
  const provided = request.headers.get("x-sovereign-key");
  if (!provided) return { ok: false, code: 401, msg: "ACCESS_DENIED" };

  // If you set env.SOVEREIGN_KEY, enforce exact match. Otherwise presence-only.
  const expected = env.SOVEREIGN_KEY;
  if (expected && provided !== expected) {
    return { ok: false, code: 403, msg: "ACCESS_DENIED" };
  }
  return { ok: true };
}

/* -------------------------------- Worker -------------------------------- */

export default {
  async fetch(request, env) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const origin = request.headers.get("Origin") || "*";
    const CORS = corsHeaders(origin);

    if (request.method === "OPTIONS") return text("", 204, CORS);

    try {
      // HEALTH (public)
      if (url.pathname === "/health" && request.method === "GET") {
        return json(
          {
            ok: true,
            status: "ONLINE",
            version: env.PHOENIX_VERSION || "unknown",
            gospel: "444",
            endpoints: ["/health", "/verifychain", "/ledger/append"],
          },
          200,
          CORS
        );
      }

      // VERIFYCHAIN (auth)
      if (url.pathname === "/verifychain" && request.method === "GET") {
        const a = requireSovereign(request, env);
        if (!a.ok) return text(a.msg, a.code, CORS);

        const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("OMEGA_PRIME");
        const stubbedReq = new Request(request.url, request);
        return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(stubbedReq);
      }

      // APPEND (auth)
      if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && request.method === "POST") {
        const a = requireSovereign(request, env);
        if (!a.ok) return text(a.msg, a.code, CORS);

        const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("OMEGA_PRIME");
        const stubbedReq = new Request(request.url, request);
        return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(stubbedReq);
      }

      return text("NOT_FOUND", 404, CORS);
    } catch (e) {
      return json(
        { ok: false, error: String(e?.message || e) },
        500,
        corsHeaders("*")
      );
    }
  },
};

/* ------------------------------ Durable Objects --------------------------- */

// SQLite-backed ledger with deterministic prev_hash chain + idempotency.
export class PhoenixLedgerDOv2 extends DurableObject {
  constructor(state, env) {
    super(state, env);
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
    this.sql = state.storage.sql;

    this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
      // Strict schema. No narrative. Deterministic storage.
      this.sql.exec(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (
          k TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          v TEXT NOT NULL
        );
      `);

      this.sql.exec(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blocks (
          height INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          ts TEXT NOT NULL,
          hash TEXT NOT NULL,
          prev_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
          payload TEXT NOT NULL,
          is_checkpoint INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
          policy_hash TEXT
        );
      `);

      this.sql.exec(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency (
          idem_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          height INTEGER NOT NULL,
          hash TEXT NOT NULL,
          ts TEXT NOT NULL
        );
      `);

      // Initialize genesis if needed.
      const r = this.sql.exec(`SELECT v FROM meta WHERE k='height'`).toArray();
      if (!r.length) {
        this.sql.exec(`INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta (k,v) VALUES ('height','0')`);
        this.sql.exec(
          `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta (k,v) VALUES ('head_hash','GENESIS')`
        );
      }
    });
  }

  _getMeta(key) {
    const r = this.sql.exec(`SELECT v FROM meta WHERE k=?`, key).toArray();
    return r.length ? r[0].v : null;
  }

  _setMeta(key, val) {
    this.sql.exec(`INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta (k,v) VALUES (?,?)`, key, val);
  }

  _getHeight() {
    return safeInt(this._getMeta("height"), 0);
  }

  _getHeadHash() {
    return this._getMeta("head_hash") || "GENESIS";
  }

  async fetch(request) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);

    // VERIFYCHAIN (read-only, deterministic)
    if (url.pathname === "/verifychain" && request.method === "GET") {
      const height = this._getHeight();
      const head_hash = this._getHeadHash();
      return json({
        ok: true,
        stone_sky: true,
        height,
        head_hash,
      });
    }

    // APPEND
    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && request.method === "POST") {
      const idem = request.headers.get("x-idempotency-key") || "";

      // If idempotency key exists and already committed, return prior result.
      if (idem) {
        const prior = this.sql
          .exec(
            `SELECT height, hash, ts FROM idempotency WHERE idem_key=?`,
            idem
          )
          .toArray();
        if (prior.length) {
          return json({
            ok: true,
            status: "COMMITTED",
            idempotent: true,
            height: prior[0].height,
            hash: prior[0].hash,
            ts: prior[0].ts,
          });
        }
      }

      const payloadObj = await request.json();
      const payloadStr = JSON.stringify(payloadObj);

      const cadence = safeInt(this.env.CHECKPOINT_CADENCE, 100);
      const policyHash = String(this.env.POLICY_HASH || "UNVERIFIED");

      const maxAttempts = 3;

      for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
        try {
          // Transaction boundaries (best-effort). If conflict occurs, retry.
          this.sql.exec("BEGIN");

          const height = this._getHeight();
          const prevHash = this._getHeadHash();

          const nextHeight = height + 1;
          const ts = nowIso();

          const isCheckpoint = cadence > 0 && nextHeight % cadence === 0;
          const policy = isCheckpoint ? policyHash : null;

          const material = `${nextHeight}:${prevHash}:${ts}:${payloadStr}:${policy || ""}`;
          const hash = await sha256Hex(material);

          // Enforce linearity: unique primary key on height + deterministic prev hash.
          // If a concurrent write happened, INSERT will fail or meta mismatch will be detected.
          this.sql.exec(
            `INSERT INTO blocks (height, ts, hash, prev_hash, payload, is_checkpoint, policy_hash)
             VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
            nextHeight,
            ts,
            hash,
            prevHash,
            payloadStr,
            isCheckpoint ? 1 : 0,
            policy
          );

          // Update meta
          this._setMeta("height", String(nextHeight));
          this._setMeta("head_hash", hash);

          // Record idempotency mapping only after successful commit.
          if (idem) {
            this.sql.exec(
              `INSERT INTO idempotency (idem_key, height, hash, ts) VALUES (?,?,?,?)`,
              idem,
              nextHeight,
              hash,
              ts
            );
          }

          this.sql.exec("COMMIT");

          return json({
            ok: true,
            status: "COMMITTED",
            height: nextHeight,
            hash,
            ts,
            checkpoint: !!isCheckpoint,
            policy_sealed: !!policy,
          });
        } catch (e) {
          // Roll back and retry a bounded number of times.
          try {
            this.sql.exec("ROLLBACK");
          } catch (_) {}

          if (attempt >= maxAttempts) {
            return json(
              {
                ok: false,
                status: "FAIL_CLOSED",
                error: String(e?.message || e),
                attempts: maxAttempts,
              },
              409
            );
          }
          // short jitter to avoid hot collision
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5 * attempt));
        }
      }
    }

    return text("NOT_FOUND", 404);
  }
}

export class RateLimiter extends DurableObject {
  constructor(state, env) {
    super(state, env);
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
  }

  async fetch(request) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    if (url.pathname !== "/check") return text("NOT_FOUND", 404);

    const key = request.headers.get("x-sovereign-key") || "anon";
    const cap = safeInt(this.env.RL_CAPACITY, 60); // tokens
    const refillPerSec = Number(this.env.RL_REFILL_PER_SEC || "1"); // tokens/sec

    const now = Date.now();
    const bucketKey = `b:${key}`;
    const lastKey = `t:${key}`;

    const bucket = safeInt(await this.state.storage.get(bucketKey), cap);
    const last = safeInt(await this.state.storage.get(lastKey), now);

    const elapsed = Math.max(0, (now - last) / 1000);
    const refilled = Math.min(cap, bucket + elapsed * refillPerSec);

    if (refilled < 1) {
      await this.state.storage.put(bucketKey, refilled);
      await this.state.storage.put(lastKey, now);
      return json({ ok: false, allowed: false, retry_after_ms: 250 }, 429);
    }

    await this.state.storage.put(bucketKey, refilled - 1);
    await this.state.storage.put(lastKey, now);
    return json({ ok: true, allowed: true });
  }
}

            `${nextHeight}:${prevHash}:${ts}:${payloadStr}:${policy || ""}`
          );

          this.sql.exec(
            `INSERT INTO blocks (height, ts, hash, prev_hash, payload, is_checkpoint, policy_hash)
             VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
            nextHeight,
            ts,
            hash,
            prevHash,
            payloadStr,
            isCheckpoint ? 1 : 0,
            policy
          );

          this._setMeta("height", String(nextHeight));
          this._setMeta("head_hash", hash);

          if (idem) {
            this.sql.exec(
              `INSERT INTO idempotency (idem_key, height, hash, ts) VALUES (?,?,?,?)`,
              idem,
              nextHeight,
              hash,
              ts
            );
          }

          this.sql.exec("COMMIT");
          return json({
            ok: true,
            status: "COMMITTED",
            height: nextHeight,
            hash,
            ts,
            checkpoint: !!isCheckpoint,
            policy_sealed: !!policy,
          });
        } catch (e) {
          try { this.sql.exec("ROLLBACK"); } catch (_) {}
          if (attempt >= 3) {
            return json(
              { ok: false, status: "FAIL_CLOSED", error: String(e?.message || e) },
              409
            );
          }
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5 * attempt));
        }
      }
    }

    return text("NOT_FOUND", 404);
  }
}

    const now = Date.now();
    const bk = `b:${key}`, tk = `t:${key}`;
    const bucket = safeInt(await this.state.storage.get(bk), cap);
    const last = safeInt(await this.state.storage.get(tk), now);
    const elapsed = Math.max(0, (now - last) / 1000);
    const refilled = Math.min(cap, bucket + elapsed * refill);
    if (refilled < 1) {
      await this.state.storage.put(bk, refilled);
      await this.state.storage.put(tk, now);
      return json({ ok: false, allowed: false }, 429);
    }
    await this.state.storage.put(bk, refilled - 1);
    await this.state.storage.put(tk, now);
    return json({ ok: true, allowed: true });
  }

// FILE: src/index.js
"use strict";

/**
 * Phoenix Rising Protocol — Hardened Worker + Durable Objects
 * - Fail-closed auth on protected endpoints
 * - Ledger DO (SQLite) with checkpoint anchoring + SHA-256 chain
 * - /health (public), /verifychain (auth), /ledger/append (auth)
 * - Optional RateLimiter DO (token bucket)
 */

function json(body, status = 200, extraHeaders = {}) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
      ...extraHeaders,
    },
  });
}

function text(body, status = 200, extraHeaders = {}) {
  return new Response(body, {
    status,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
      ...extraHeaders,
    },
  });
}

function cors(origin = "*") {
  return {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": origin,
    "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET,POST,OPTIONS",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, x-sovereign-key, x-chat-key",
    "Access-Control-Max-Age": "86400",
    "Vary": "Origin",
  };
}

function requireKey(req, env) {
  const got = req.headers.get("x-sovereign-key") || "";
  const expected = (env.SOVEREIGN_KEY || "").trim();

  // Fail-closed: if no expected key is configured, treat as locked.
  if (!expected) return false;
  if (!got) return false;
  return timingSafeEq(got, expected);
}

// constant-time-ish compare (guards simple timing leaks); handles empty strings safely
function timingSafeEq(a, b) {
  if (typeof a !== "string" || typeof b !== "string") return false;
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  if (a.length === 0) return false;
  let out = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) out |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return out === 0;
}

async function sha256Hex(str) {
  const buf = new TextEncoder().encode(str);
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buf);
  return [...new Uint8Array(digest)].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

function mustInt(str, fallback) {
  const n = Number.parseInt(String(str ?? ""), 10);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
}

function nowISO() {
  return new Date().toISOString();
}

export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);

    // CORS preflight
    if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {
      return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: cors("*") });
    }

    // Public health
    if (url.pathname === "/health" && request.method === "GET") {
      return json(
        {
          ok: true,
          status: "ONLINE",
          version: env.PHOENIX_VERSION || "UNSET",
          gospel: env.GOSPEL || "444",
          checkpoint_cadence: env.CHECKPOINT_CADENCE || "100",
        },
        200,
        cors("*")
      );
    }

    // Protected endpoints
    const protectedPaths = new Set(["/verifychain", "/ledger/append"]);
    if (protectedPaths.has(url.pathname)) {
      if (!requireKey(request, env)) {
        return text("ACCESS_DENIED", 401, cors("*"));
      }
    }

    // Optional rate limit gate (recommended for /ledger/append)
    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append") {
      const useRL = String(env.RL_ENABLED || "1") !== "0";
      if (useRL && env.RATELIMITER) {
        const rlId = env.RATELIMITER.idFromName("GLOBAL");
        const rlRes = await env.RATELIMITER.get(rlId).fetch("https://rl/check", {
          method: "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            key: "ledger_append",
            cost: 1,
          }),
        });
        if (!rlRes.ok) {
          const payload = await rlRes.text();
          return new Response(payload, { status: rlRes.status, headers: cors("*") });
        }
      }
    }

    // Route into Ledger DO (singleton)
    if (url.pathname === "/verifychain" && request.method === "GET") {
      const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("OMEGA_PRIME");
      return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(request);
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && request.method === "POST") {
      const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("OMEGA_PRIME");
      return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(request);
    }

    return text("NOT_FOUND", 404, cors("*"));
  },
};

// -------------------- Durable Objects --------------------

export class PhoenixLedgerDOv2 {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
    this.sql = state.storage.sql;

    // Boot: create schema once
    this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
      this.sql.exec(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ledger (
          height INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          hash TEXT NOT NULL,
          prev_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
          payload TEXT NOT NULL,
          ts TEXT NOT NULL,
          type TEXT NOT NULL,
          policy_hash TEXT
        );
      `);

      // Ensure metadata row exists via storage (not SQL) for fast reads
      const h = await this.state.storage.get("height");
      if (typeof h !== "number") await this.state.storage.put("height", 0);
      const head = await this.state.storage.get("latest_hash");
      if (typeof head !== "string") await this.state.storage.put("latest_hash", "GENESIS");
    });
  }

  async fetch(request) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);

    if (url.pathname === "/verifychain" && request.method === "GET") {
      const height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) || 0;
      const headHash = (await this.state.storage.get("latest_hash")) || "GENESIS";
      const policyHash = String(this.env.POLICY_HASH || "UNVERIFIED");
      return json({
        ok: true,
        stone_sky: true,
        height,
        head_hash: headHash,
        policy_hash: policyHash,
        version: this.env.PHOENIX_VERSION || "UNSET",
      });
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && request.method === "POST") {
      const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
      if (!body || typeof body !== "object") return text("BAD_JSON", 400);

      const cadence = mustInt(this.env.CHECKPOINT_CADENCE, 100);
      const policyHash = String(this.env.POLICY_HASH || "UNVERIFIED");

      // Atomic-ish append (single-threaded per DO, still guard against partial writes)
      const height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) || 0;
      const prevHash = (await this.state.storage.get("latest_hash")) || "GENESIS";
      const nextHeight = height + 1;

      const ts = nowISO();
      const isCheckpoint = cadence > 0 && nextHeight % cadence === 0;

      const type = isCheckpoint ? "CHECKPOINT" : "STANDARD";
      const payloadObj = isCheckpoint
        ? { ...body, policy_verification: policyHash, type: "CHECKPOINT" }
        : { ...body };

      const payload = JSON.stringify(payloadObj);
      const newHash = await sha256Hex(`${nextHeight}:${prevHash}:${ts}:${payload}`);

      // Write SQL row
      this.sql.exec(
        "INSERT INTO ledger (height, hash, prev_hash, payload, ts, type, policy_hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);",
        nextHeight,
        newHash,
        prevHash,
        payload,
        ts,
        type,
        isCheckpoint ? policyHash : null
      );

      // Update fast head pointers
      await this.state.storage.put("height", nextHeight);
      await this.state.storage.put("latest_hash", newHash);

      return json({
        ok: true,
        status: "COMMITTED",
        height: nextHeight,
        hash: newHash,
        type,
        checkpoint: isCheckpoint,
      });
    }

    return text("DO_NOT_FOUND", 404);
  }
}

export class PhoenixSessionStore {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
  }
  async fetch() {
    return text("OK", 200);
  }
}

export class PhoenixMemoryDO {

    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
  }
  async fetch() {
    return text("OK", 200);
  }
}

// Simple token-bucket rate limiter (DO-scoped)
export class RateLimiter {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
  }

  async fetch(request) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    if (url.pathname !== "/check") return text("NOT_FOUND", 404);

    const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
    const key = String(body?.key || "default");
    const cost = mustInt(body?.cost, 1);

    const cap = mustInt(this.env.RL_CAPACITY, 60);
    const refillPerSec = mustInt(this.env.RL_REFILL_PER_SEC, 1);

    const now = Date.now();
    const recKey = `rl:${key}`;

    const rec =
      (await this.state.storage.get(recKey)) ||
      ({ tokens: cap, ts: now } /* seed */);

    const elapsedSec = Math.max(0, (now - rec.ts) / 1000);
    const refill = Math.floor(elapsedSec * refillPerSec);
    const tokens = Math.min(cap, rec.tokens + refill);

    if (tokens < cost) {
      await this.state.storage.put(recKey, { tokens, ts: now });
      return json({ ok: false, error: "RATE_LIMIT", tokens, cap }, 429);
    }

    const next = tokens - cost;
    await this.state.storage.put(recKey, { tokens: next, ts: now });
    return json({ ok: true, tokens: next, cap }, 200);
  }
}

Revenue Engine Autonomy Spec (scale to 1B VND)

Core objective: convert inbound signals (leads, payments, student actions) into deterministic ledger events with strict idempotency, bounded retries, and auditable outcomes.

A. Event model (immutable)

Every revenue-relevant action is an event: LEAD_INGESTED, TIGER_SCORED, INVOICE_CREATED, PAYMENT_CONFIRMED, REFUND_ISSUED, CONTRACT_RENEWED.

Each event includes:

event_id (UUID or deterministic hash)

actor_id (lead/student/operator)

amount_vnd (0 allowed for non-monetary)

source (manychat/webhook/manual)

timestamp

idempotency_key (required for anything that can be retried)

B. Idempotency (non-negotiable)

Idempotency key format: "<source>:<external_id>:<event_type>".

Ledger enforces “at most once” per idempotency key:

Store a seen:<idempotency_key> -> committed_height/hash index (in DO storage or SQL unique index).

If key exists: return the prior commit response (do not append a new block).

C. CAS / retry policy (bounded)

If using a compare-and-swap pattern (or you detect head changed mid-flow), retry up to N=3.

Backoff: 0ms / 25ms / 75ms, then fail closed with an explicit error that can be re-queued.

Never infinite loops. Never “best effort” silent success.

D. Autonomy guardrails

Budget guard: per-event cost cap; if exceeded, degrade to “queue for review”.

TMST guard: any autonomous task must produce either:

a ledger state mutation, or

a durable “queued outcome”
within 600 seconds, else it is killed and marked TIMEOUT_ABORTED.

Rate limiting:

Global and per-actor throttles (token bucket).

Hard 429, never 500.

E. Scaling architecture (recommended)

Ingest Worker: validates signatures + normalizes events + emits to queue (or directly calls Ledger if low volume).

Queue/Buffer (if volume spikes): batches events, preserves ordering per actor.

Ledger DO: single-writer authoritative chain (your PhoenixLedgerDOv2).

Auditor DO/Cron: periodic verification:

head continuity

checkpoint cadence compliance

policy hash matches configured expected policy hash

anomaly detection (duplicate payments, negative totals, sudden spikes)

F. “1B VND” progress computation (stable)

Do not compute progress by scanning entire chain per request.

Maintain rolling aggregates in DO storage:

revenue_total_vnd

revenue_by_day

revenue_by_source

Update aggregates only on append commit, derived from the event payload.

G. Failure modes (explicit)

ACCESS_DENIED (401)

RATE_LIMIT (429)

DUPLICATE_EVENT (200 with prior receipt)

BAD_EVENT (400)

INTERNAL_ERROR (500) — should be rare; treat as incident.

H. Observability

Log correlation id: request_id.

Emit structured logs for:

event accepted/rejected

idempotency hit

append commit receipt (height/hash)

retry attempts

checkpoint creation

      const h = await this.state.storage.get("height");
      if (typeof h !== "number") await this.state.storage.put("height", 0);
      const head = await this.state.storage.get("latest_hash");
      if (typeof head !== "string") await this.state.storage.put("latest_hash", "GENESIS");
    });
  }

  async fetch(req) {
    const url = new URL(req.url);

    if (url.pathname === "/verifychain" && req.method === "GET") {
      const height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) || 0;
      const head = (await this.state.storage.get("latest_hash")) || "GENESIS";
      return json({
        ok: true,
        stone_sky: true,
        height,
        head_hash: head,
        policy_hash: String(this.env.POLICY_HASH || "UNVERIFIED"),
        version: this.env.PHOENIX_VERSION || "UNSET",
      });
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && req.method === "POST") {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => null);
      if (!body || typeof body !== "object") return text("BAD_JSON", 400);

      const cadence = mustInt(this.env.CHECKPOINT_CADENCE, 100);
      const policyHash = String(this.env.POLICY_HASH || "UNVERIFIED");

      const height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) || 0;
      const prev = (await this.state.storage.get("latest_hash")) || "GENESIS";
      const next = height + 1;
      const ts = nowISO();
      const checkpoint = cadence > 0 && next % cadence === 0;
      const type = checkpoint ? "CHECKPOINT" : "STANDARD";
      const payloadObj = checkpoint ? { ...body, policy_verification: policyHash, type: "CHECKPOINT" } : { ...body };
      const payload = JSON.stringify(payloadObj);
      const hash = await sha256Hex(`${next}:${prev}:${ts}:${payload}`);

      this.sql.exec(
        "INSERT INTO ledger (height, hash, prev_hash, payload, ts, type, policy_hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);",
        next,
        hash,
        prev,
        payload,
        ts,
        type,
        checkpoint ? policyHash : null
      );

      await this.state.storage.put("height", next);
      await this.state.storage.put("latest_hash", hash);

      return json({ ok: true, status: "COMMITTED", height: next, hash, type, checkpoint });
    }

    return text("DO_NOT_FOUND", 404);
  }
}

export class PhoenixSessionStore {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
  }
  async fetch() {
    return text("OK", 200);
  }
}

export class PhoenixMemoryDO {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
  }
  async fetch() {
    return text("OK", 200);
  }
}

export class RateLimiter {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
  }
  async fetch(req) {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    if (url.pathname !== "/check") return text("NOT_FOUND", 404);

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => null);
    const key = String(body?.key || "default");
    const cost = mustInt(body?.cost, 1);

    const cap = mustInt(this.env.RL_CAPACITY, 60);
    const refillPerSec = mustInt(this.env.RL_REFILL_PER_SEC, 1);

    const now = Date.now();
    const k = `rl:${key}`;
    const rec = (await this.state.storage.get(k)) || { tokens: cap, ts: now };

    const elapsed = Math.max(0, (now - rec.ts) / 1000);
    const refill = Math.floor(elapsed * refillPerSec);
    const tokens = Math.min(cap, rec.tokens + refill);

    if (tokens < cost) {
      await this.state.storage.put(k, { tokens, ts: now });
      return json({ ok: false, error: "RATE_LIMIT", tokens, cap }, 429);
    }

    const next = tokens - cost;
    await this.state.storage.put(k, { tokens: next, ts: now });
    return json({ ok: true, tokens: next, cap }, 200);
  }
}
